name: Max Points
description: Displays an alert with the number of words, panagrams and total possible points.

name: Missing Words
description: Displays an alert with a list of the words that haven't been found yet.

name: First Letters
description: Displays an alert with a matrix showing the number of remaining words starting with all possible letter pairs

name: In-Page Data
description: Adds two automatically updating matricies to the spelling bee page. One lists the number of remaining words starting with all possible letter pairs. The other shows the number of words starting with each letter by word length.
